topic: Something you would like to replace

part2.title: Describe something in your home that you would like to replace.
bullets: how long it has been there
part2.closing: and explain what you would like to have instead of it.
follow_up: Has anyone tried to repair it?
Would anyone else at home miss it?

items.prompt: Why do people put off replacing things that no longer work properly?
